unit_department: Institute for Advanced Materials and Manufacturing
description_1line: UT Knoxville institute advancing the understanding of materials and their translation with industry, government, and academic partners; its own site names Polymer Science as one of five key research areas, with a dedicated Polymer Science page, researcher roster, and a Polymer Characterization Lab among its core facilities.
facilities_note: IAMM headquarters facility at UT's Cherokee Farm campus (140,000 ft2); core facilities include the Polymer Characterization Lab, described on IAMM's own site as a 'premier global academic laboratory for characterizing polymers via molecular weight, molecular weight distribution, conformation, size, and thermal properties', serving users from across UT as well as external users from industry and national laboratories.
